update.title: Expanded Portfolio Editor drag-and-drop beyond images
update.summary: Added drag-and-drop and attachment controls for documents, videos, source files, diagrams, and chart data, while keeping files temporary until Save.

blocks.body:
## Drop more than images

Portfolio Editor could already turn dropped images into image or gallery blocks. This update extended the same interaction to PDFs, videos, Markdown files, source code, Mermaid diagrams, and structured chart data.

Each file is matched by extension and inserted at the drop position as the corresponding block.

blocks.code:
README.md   → README block
demo.mp4    → video block
diagram.mmd → Mermaid block
data.csv    → graph block
script.py   → code block
blocks.description: The file extension selects the block type and populates its file-backed field.

blocks.body:
## Attach files from the block editor

I also added attachment controls to file-backed fields for images, galleries, videos, READMEs, PDFs, code, Mermaid diagrams, terminal transcripts, comparisons, and graph data.

Choosing a file populates the open block and refreshes the preview without requiring a path to be entered by hand.
